meta.name: clinical-decision-support
meta.description: Generate professional clinical decision support (CDS) documents for pharmaceutical and clinical research settings, including patient cohort analyses (biomarker-stratified with outcomes) and treatment recommendation reports (evidence-based guidelines with decision algorithms). Supports GRADE evidence grading, statistical analysis (hazard ratios, survival curves, waterfall plots), biomarker integration, and regulatory compliance. Outputs publication-ready LaTeX/PDF format optimized for drug development, clinical research, and evidence synthesis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成临床决策支持文档与患者队列分析报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为药物研发或临床研究撰写循证决策文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate clinical decision support documents and patient cohort analysis reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write evidence-based decision documents for drug development or clinical research

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能生成专业的临床决策支持文档，包括患者队列分析（按生物标志物分层并统计结果）和治疗推荐报告（基于证据的指南与决策算法）。输出可直接发表的 LaTeX/PDF 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要分析生物标志物分层的患者队列、生成带证据分级的治疗推荐报告，或为药物研发、临床试验制作研究文档时触发。

say.text: 请生成一份针对HER2阳性乳腺癌的生物标志物分层队列分析报告。
制作一份非小细胞肺癌的治疗推荐报告，使用GRADE分级。
say.note: Claude 会输出带决策算法和证据分级的指南。

say.text: 为我的临床试验数据生成一份患者队列分析，包含Kaplan-Meier曲线。
say.note: Claude 会整合数据并生成出版级 PDF。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate professional clinical decision support documents, including patient cohort analyses (biomarker-stratified with outcomes) and treatment recommendation reports (evidence-based guidelines with decision algorithms). Outputs publication-ready LaTeX/PDF files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze biomarker-stratified patient cohorts, generate treatment recommendation reports with evidence grading, or create pharmaceutical research documents for drug development or clinical trials.

say_en.text: Generate a biomarker-stratified cohort analysis report for HER2-positive breast cancer.
Create a treatment recommendation report for non-small cell lung cancer using GRADE grading.
say_en.note: Claude will output a guideline with decision algorithms and evidence grading.

say_en.text: Produce a patient cohort analysis for my clinical trial data including Kaplan-Meier curves.
say_en.note: Claude will integrate data and generate a publication-ready PDF.
